sourceOccurrences.label: Complete named-statement source index
sourceOccurrences.relationship: Source-inspected contracts; grouped exposition with explicit scope limits
sourceOccurrences.note: The seventeen source statements include one-coordinate covariance; measurable splicing without probability hypotheses; product-law preservation; bounded section integrability; an integrable-function mean identity; monotonicity under coordinate preorders; averaging measurability, norm bounds, finite dependence and fixed functions; L1 contraction; finite-dimensional association; directed finite-coordinate approximation; general measurable-event Harris and its two Bernoulli numerical forms. Some helpers use total integral conventions without section integrability or function measurability. WBBE presents their ordinary measurable/integrable specializations and does not claim the unrestricted helper contracts as classical integration statements. This source index records those distinctions, not full one-to-one assertion correspondence.

sourceOccurrences.label: One coordinate and finite-dimensional association
sourceOccurrences.note: P52U gives the one-dimensional integral inequality; 9U6I gives finite-coordinate bounded-function association. Linear order and measurability are separate hypotheses.

sourceOccurrences.label: Splicing and averaging
sourceOccurrences.note: WBBE gives measurable splicing, the preserved product law, mean identities, sup and L1 contraction, finite dependence and monotonicity. Integrable functions have almost-everywhere integrable sections. Statements about nonmeasurable functions under Lean’s total integral convention are not asserted as ordinary integration theorems.

sourceOccurrences.label: Cylinder approximation and arbitrary-product association
sourceOccurrences.note: NPRG keeps the all-finite-supersets quantifier. 9U6I passes to measurable increasing events without enumerating the coordinate set or requiring finite open witnesses. The Bernoulli specialization is X5SS.
